shufps xmm1,xmm2,0xbb
pshufd xmm2,xmm2,0xb1

137359a19b.why: SHUFPS with immediate 0xbb directly selects lanes 3 and 2 from each original input, replacing the xmm1 shuffle and high-qword unpack. The remaining operations preserve xmm2, xmm7, both stores, and all flags.
